# Petar Arsić Portfolio

> Petar Arsić is a freelance full-stack developer (Laravel, PHP, React, WordPress) in Belgrade, Serbia. He builds websites, booking/reservation systems, tourism portals, admin panels and custom business web apps end to end, from design to server and maintenance. Clients work with him directly, without agency markup: business websites from €450, booking websites from €900, custom web apps from €2,500, with a fixed quote within 48 hours. 5+ years in production; his booking platform has processed 150,000+ tickets and reservations.

## About

Petar Arsić is a full-stack developer focused on booking systems, tourism and accommodation portals, admin panels/dashboards, CRM and internal business tools, WordPress/WooCommerce sites, and custom Laravel + React web applications. His flagship product, DriveSoft, powers online seat reservations, QR-code ticket validation, payment processing with fiscal-receipt integration, and role-based admin tools for international bus carriers.

- [Cenovnik (SR)](https://petararsic.rs/sr/cenovnik) — Koliko košta izrada sajta: prezentacioni sajt od 450 €, sajt sa rezervacijama od 900 €, online prodavnica od 800 €, web aplikacija po meri od 2.500 €, održavanje od 50 € mesečno

## Good fit for

- Small and medium businesses in Serbia, the region and the diaspora that want one developer to handle the whole project (design, development, hosting, maintenance) at a freelance price instead of agency rates
- Tourism: apartments, villas, accommodation portals, travel agencies, tour and transport operators
- Companies replacing Excel, paper or email workflows with an admin panel or internal tool
- Projects that need a Serbian-speaking developer who can also deliver the product in English or German

## Key projects

- [DriveSoft](https://drivesoft.rs/) — Reservation, ticketing and operations platform for international bus carriers. 150,000+ tickets processed.
- [Srbija Tours](https://srbijatours.com/) — Public ticket-sales site sharing one source of truth with the booking backend.
- [Leto Halkidiki](https://letohalkidiki.com/) — Multilingual (sr, en, ro, el) portal for private accommodation in Halkidiki, Greece, built in Laravel. Guests book directly with owners, commission-free.
- [Srbija Tours mobile app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.panzo98.srbijatours) — Cross-platform React Native app for iOS and Android.
- [DriveSoft operations back-office](https://drivesoft-bozic.com/login) — Internal tool for managing passengers, routes, departures and daily operations.
- [Bozic Konig](https://bozic-konig.com/) — Online reservation front-end for a carrier.
- [Prostor Miljenko Dereta](https://prostordereta.org/) — Corporate site with blog and space-booking forms on custom WordPress.

## Tech stack

Laravel, PHP, MySQL, React, Next.js, React Native, Expo, Redis, Docker, DigitalOcean, WordPress, Nginx, Plausible Analytics

## Specialties

Booking & ticketing systems, tourism and accommodation portals, payment & fiscalization integration, QR-code ticket validation, role-based admin panels and CRM tools, WordPress/WooCommerce sites, transport operations software, full-stack SaaS development

## Availability

Taking on freelance projects now. Remote, async-first, Belgrade, Serbia (CET/CEST). Communicates in Serbian and English. Last updated: 2026-09-23.
